description: This is a Java source file implementing a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel that generates URLs specific to the OFBiz web application framework. It provides a transform for use within Freemarker templates to generate URLs with various options such as full path, security, encoding, and web site context.

classes.name: OfbizUrlTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class that generates OFBiz URLs with configurable options such as full URL, secure protocol, shortening, encoding, and web site context. It integrates with OFBiz's URL building and request handling infrastructure to produce context-aware links within templates.

methods.name: checkBooleanArg
methods.description: Utility method to check and parse a boolean argument from the transform's argument map, defaulting if not present.

methods.name: convertToString
methods.description: Utility method to convert an object (often a TemplateScalarModel) into a string, with verbose logging if enabled.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Main method that returns a Writer which constructs the URL or link during template rendering, handling various options and environmental variables.
